transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because I’ve been feeling like the better part of my life is already behind me. Like no matter how much I try to plan or keep things in order, I’m not really getting back to feeling like myself. It’s hard to shake.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things anymore or lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… not in a clear way. I still do some of the same things. Maybe they don’t feel quite the same, but I wouldn’t say I’ve completely lost interest.
Have you been feeling down or sad most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
Most days, yes… not crying or anything like that. It’s more just this low, gray feeling underneath things, even when I’m doing normal things, like being in the studio or having dinner with my wife.
Have you noticed feeling fatigued or a lack of energy lately, even when you haven’t done much physically or mentally?

Yes… somewhat. I still get up and do the shopping, tinker with things around the house. But smaller things can wear me out more than they should — setting up for a mentoring session, or just walking around one of those community events. Afterward I feel drained, and a nap doesn’t really seem to fix it.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you’re not living up to who you should be, even when things aren’t necessarily your fault?
I’m not sure I’d put it that way. I mean… I can be hard on myself sometimes, but I don’t think I’ve been feeling especially guilty, no.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or thinking clearly lately, even when you’re trying to focus on something simple?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have the usual moments of walking into a room and forgetting why, but nothing I’d really call trouble concentrating.
Have you been feeling this way — down or sad — most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?

Yes… most days, I’d say. It’s not like I’m crying all the time or anything. It’s more just this low, gray feeling underneath things, even when I’m doing something I usually care about, or just having dinner with my wife.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately — like eating more or less than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?
Not really. My weight seems about the same, and I haven’t noticed much change in how I’m eating.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and unable to sit still lately?
No… I haven’t really noticed that. I don’t think I’m moving or talking any differently, and I’m not especially restless.
Have you noticed any days where you felt so slowed down physically, like even small tasks take a lot of effort, or the opposite — where you felt so restless that you couldn’t stay still?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, things can feel like a chore, but not like I’m physically slowed down or can’t sit still.
Have you felt this way — with a low, depressed mood — for most of the time over the past couple of months or more?

Yes… most days, I’d say. It’s not like I’m crying or anything, but there’s just this kind of gray feeling underneath things. Even when I’m in the studio, or just having dinner with my wife, it’s sort of still there.
About how long have you been feeling this way — with this low, gray mood — most days?
A little over three years, I guess. Since that hiking injury… about three years and three months now.
Have you had periods where you felt this low mood almost every day for at least two years or more, without a clear break in symptoms?
Yes… I don’t think there’s been a real clear break. It’s been going on since that hiking injury, a little over three years ago — about three years and three months now.
